code='''def transform(grid):
    # Each 3x3 patch becomes one output cell; colors other than 0 and 5
    # are the markers carried into the compressed grid.
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[0 for _ in range(width // 3)] for _ in range(height // 3)]
    for r in range(height):
